_comment: Internal, machine-readable manifest of which .ai/hooks/*.mjs script is expected to implement which capability, per harness config file. Consumed by .ai/validate.mjs's checkHookCapabilityManifest — not user-facing, not a README source.

knownGaps.session-bootstrap: OpenCode's plugin API for injecting system-prompt context at session start was not verified when this was written (candidates: session.start, chat.message, experimental.chat.system.transform — none confirmed). using-superpowers is not automatically bootstrapped here; a user should paste .ai/skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md at session start, or invoke it explicitly, until this is verified and wired.

Pi's ExtensionAPI event for injecting system-prompt context at session start was not verified when this was written. using-superpowers is not automatically bootstrapped here; a user should paste .ai/skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md at session start, or invoke it explicitly, until this is verified and wired.
